summary: Episodes 21-50 adapt NOTHING: every consulted source agrees the anime follows the manga only through ep 20 (manga ch 15, the pre-timeskip material) and from ep 21 onward tells a wholly anime-original story through its own finale — there are no periodic returns to manga material anywhere in 21-50, so the correct deliverable is type corrections plus a divergence annotation, not anchors. The anime performs its own version of the manga's 2-year timeskip at ep 21 (fandom ep-21 synopsis opens 'Two years have passed'), then runs an episodic original stretch (~21-31) followed by a serialized original arc built around the anime-only character Sae and final antagonist Abe no Seimei (~32-50), ending with an original Yuto battle that contradicts the manga (anime kills Yuto; in the manga he survives well past this point and dies much later under different circumstances). Ep 20 itself is mixed: only the first half (to ~14:05) adapts ch 14-15; the back half (Benio losing her legs, Kamui's Kegare limbs) is anime-original — animefillerguide types it Mixed. Because the anime stops exactly at the timeskip boundary, the continue point is a clean ch 16 (= END+1 of the ep-20 anchor), matching the DB's continue_from_chapter=16. Filler-list sites label 21-50 'filler'; typed here as anime-only-canon since it is the anime's serialized canonical continuation and finale, not throwaway episodic filler.

Shares only skeleton elements with later manga (2-year timeskip, Mayura's growth as an exorcist, Twelve Guardians, a Yuto rematch) — all executed with different events, order, and outcomes; no episode adapts any specific chapter.
Canon only to ~14:05 (ch 14-15); back half (Benio's legs lost, Kamui's Kegare limbs, timeskip setup) is anime-original — animefillerguide types the episode Mixed.
